title: A deterministic exact Hausdorff gauge for ordinary SLE
exact_target: For each fixed $0<\kappa <8$, does there exist a deterministic continuous nondecreasing Hausdorff gauge $h_\kappa $ such that ordinary chordal $SLE_\kappa $ in the upper half-plane, parametrized by half-plane capacity 2t, has positive finite $h_\kappa -Hausdorff$ measure on every segment gamma([s,t]), simultaneously for all real $0<s<t<infinity$ almost surely?
